# Wit.ai

Wit.ai is a natural language processing platform that enables developers to build applications and devices that understand human language.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wit-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Wit.ai App**: Create a new app in wit.ai.
- **Create Wit.ai Trait**: Create a new trait in wit.ai.
- **Delete App**: Delete a specific app from wit.ai.
- **Get App Details**: Retrieve metadata and settings of a wit.ai app.
- **Get Intent Details**: Retrieve details of a specific intent.
- **Get Intents**: List all intents in a wit.ai app.
- **Get Trait Details**: Retrieve details of a specific trait.
- **List Traits**: List all traits in a wit.ai app.
- **Update Wit.ai App**: Update an existing wit.ai app.
- **Wit.ai Get Message**: Analyze a text message and extract its intent, entities, and traits.
